name: ready-prs
description: Shows the repository's open pull requests that are ready to merge, just above the prompt

readiness.title: Readiness rule
readiness.description: clean: GitHub reports the PR as CLEAN. clean-or-unstable: also count PRs whose only failures are optional checks. approved: CLEAN and approved by a reviewer.

maxRows.title: Rows shown
maxRows.description: How many ready PRs the band lists before it says +N more (1 to 10).

pollMinutes.title: Check every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often the mod asks GitHub again. /ready-prs checks right away.
